historical_validation_track.eligible_features: Only features with point-in-time primary evidence and adequate cross-company coverage.
rules: Future outcomes join only after score construction.
No post-result changes to bands, weights or admission thresholds.
Parser/source corrections are allowed only for independently justified chronology/schema correctness and must replay retained raw evidence.
A component cannot be admitted merely because it improves one development anchor.

prospective_validation_track.snapshot_policy: Persist universe, source hashes/URLs, normalized evidence, feature values, coverage, score, classification, funnel rank and thesis state before future return is known.
source_priority: reviewed secondary evidence for context only
prospective_validation_track.review_policy: Qualitative score-driving claims require explicit evidence and review; automated extraction alone cannot approve a qualitative score.

coverage_policy.historically_sparse_pillar_rule: Do not impute or backfill missing historical qualitative pillars simply to increase backtest coverage.
